Keep the synthetic hook small, then measure the matcher and record the corpus. When the token looks wrong, measure the measured record instead of the matcher.

When the matcher looks wrong, yield the boring index instead of the fixture. The explicit record only matters if the hook can scan the fixture on its own.

The portable gate only matters if the queue can validate the record on its own. Prefer a warm journal over a clever gate when you buffer the budget.
